support_claim: The billing record and contract header each name Vellum Print Co Ltd, but neither observation provides identity-establishing evidence that the billing referent and the SOW counterparty are the same or distinct legal entities.

critic.reason: Under the contract, SAME_ENTITY and DISTINCT require establishing evidence rather than name compatibility, and the packet only shows both referents share the name Vellum Print Co Ltd without any linkage such as a shared identifier, address, or explicit billing-to-contract tie.
